values.note: Forest Service-run, first-come, first-served; no reservation system. May fill on summer weekends and holidays: arrive in the early afternoon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cow-creek-campground-and-picnic-area (Reservations: 'No Reservations: This campground does not use a reservation system, it is managed on a first-come, first-served basis. ... There is a 10 day stay limit.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Accessible toilet and tables; no drinking water, no trash pickup (pack it out), no firewood.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cow-creek-campground-and-picnic-area ('Trash Pickup: No', 'Firewood: No', Accessibility 'Toilet', 'Tables', Restrooms 'Yes', Water 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/cow-creek-campground-and-picnic-area (Fee Site and Info: 'No fees are required for this site'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Ashland RD) in the Ashland-area pine country, about 25 mi south of Ashland: 4 mi east on US 212, 20 mi south on Otter Creek Rd (CR 485), then 5 mi on Cow Creek Rd (FR 4095). Campground plus a picnic site; pond fishing. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms FCFS, no fee, no potable water, toilet; changed site count 4 -> 5 ('Camp sites: 5'); added the 10-day stay limit and year-round (weather dependent) season. Not stated: toilet type, trailer length (derived 30 ft left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of the restated count, toilet/water, FCFS, fee and trailer-length text.
